description: An input whose `value` comes from React state and is updated through `onChange`.
`{ [name]: value }` uses a variable as an object key, letting one handler update any field.
Errors computed from current values during render, so they can never be out of sync.
Announce a field as invalid and link it to the element that explains the error.
Disables the browser's built-in validation bubbles so the app can render its own messages.
Stops the browser's default full-page form submission.
